what: *** Pablo Armando Lerena born at Rosario de Santa Fe. ***
source: His own Argentine passport, 1940; corroborated by "Clase de 1882" on the army enrolment card.

what: The Argentine Stud Book is created by the Jockey Club on 30 June - the year he was born.
source: Turf histories. A coincidence, recorded as one.

what: The South African War begins. Roughly 360,000 horses are shipped into the country; Argentina is one of the main sources.
The war ends. About 600 Afrikaners emigrate to Argentina - the traffic ran both ways.
His eldest son Roque Luis Armando is born at Cape Town.
*** He enrols for Argentine military service at the CAPE TOWN consulate. *** The card names his father and mother.
source: Ficha de enrolamiento, Cajon 985 (Lera), image ark 3:1:3QHK-MQL4-NQWN.

what: He marries Mary Septima Taylor at St Dominic's, Wynberg. He is a HORSE-DEALER of Diep River; both are single; both sign their own names.
source: Cape Province marriage register no. 160, ark 1:1:88RY-GF3Z.

what: Roque, born 1905, is baptised at Corpus Christi, Wynberg - three months before his parents' wedding.
source: The baptism register, naming both parents.

what: Guardia Nacional, 6th Cavalry - the service the 1908 card enrolled him for.
Ricardo JUAN CARLOS Lerena born at Claremont, Cape - carrying his Argentine grandfather's name.
source: Named with this exact date in the 1950 estate.

what: Nuno Fernando Lerena born at Wynberg, Cape. David's grandfather.
source: Named with this exact date in the 1950 estate.

what: Plans lodged for STABLES at Koeberg Road, Rugby.
source: Cape Town municipal file, KAB 3/CT 4/2/1/3/474 B796.

what: Mary Septima dies at 34 Florence Road, Observatory, aged 51. Buried Maitland, grave 7719A.
source: Cape Province civil records; Maitland interment register p.3215 entry 163.

what: Two of his sons appear in the LDS South African Mission church census - Ricardo at Claremont, Nuno at Wynberg.
*** Argentine passport Serie A No. 07962, issued at Cape Town on Christmas Eve. *** Profession: Trainer. Widower. A scar on the forehead.
source: The passport itself, in the family's papers.

what: Argentina and South Africa establish diplomatic relations - thirty-nine years AFTER the Cape Town consular office enrolled him.
He dies at 7 Forth Road, Newlands, of coronary thrombosis. Registered as "Robert Paul LERINA", Race Horse Owner, widower.
source: Union of South Africa death certificate A 214036, entry W612/50.

what: Estate: gross 15,527 pounds 15s - about half a million today - including a claim for 26 pounds of CARROTS.
source: First and Final Liquidation and Distribution Account, MOOC 6/9/17017.
